citation: Qiang Chen et al. (2023), Active and stable alcohol dehydrogenase-assembled hydrogels via synergistic bridging of triazoles and metal ions, Nature Communications, doi:10.1038/s41467-023-37921-y
quantity: acetophenone conversion measured from substrate depletion
processing: Selected raw triplicates, source means and source error cells are transcribed at their original units and cell identities.
Model observations are recomputed arithmetic means divided by 100 to give conversion fractions.
The first four times fit each preparation; the remaining four evaluate later-time predictions.
The selected source error values equal population standard deviations. D31 and D37 contain STDEVP formulas despite the SEM label. Sample SD is calculated separately.
Longitudinal pairing and independence of the three raw rows remain unspecified by their cell positions. The example uses descriptive sensitivity.

Default assay conditions are 5 mM acetophenone, 10% isopropanol, 1 mM NADP+, 1 mg/mL TbSADH content, 500 microlitres, 50 mM PBS, pH 7.4 and 30 degrees C. The two effective rate laws condition on this fixed assay context.
